svg.title: Pi TimeLens Step summaries in a real narrow Pi terminal
svg.desc: A faithful transcript redraw from Pi 0.85.1 at 40 columns. Compact Step and Total summaries reflow into complete timing and token segments without repeating individual tool timing rows.
svg.metadata: Faithful redraw of tests/fixtures/real-pi-40.txt, selected from a real Pi 0.85.1 TUI session at 40 columns on 2026-09-09. Raw capture SHA-256: bdde6b120e54bc8be806575bd61dd47308d938e68994821300ea40eb5bcc61d8. Transcript text, wrapping, ordering, measured values, and theme roles are preserved; startup, transient working/status UI, update notice, footer, model identifier, filesystem path, and assistant reasoning are omitted.

g.text: Use the read tool to read auth.ts and
